| L_portal | Phibar, Phi, Sbar, S | 4 | lambdaPhiS | 0 | n/a | 0 | 0 | singlet: Phibar[ii] Phi[ii] times Sbar S | singlet | 0 | 0 | n/a | LaTeX: -\lambda_{\Phi S} \Phi^\dagger \Phi |S|^2, Eq. (125) | self-conjugate (real) |
| L_quartic_S | Sbar, S, Sbar, S | 4 | lambdaS | 0 | n/a | 0 | 0 | singlet | singlet | 0 | 0 | n/a | LaTeX: -\frac{\lambda_S}{2} |S|^4, Eq. (125) | self-conjugate (real) |
| L_soft | S, S + Sbar, Sbar | 2 | muSprime2 | 2 | n/a | 0 | 0 | singlet | singlet | 0 | 0 | n/a | LaTeX: \frac{\mu_S'^2}{4} (S^2 + S^{*2}), Eq. (126) | HC of each other: S^2 <-> Sbar^2 |

## New Particle Class Kinetic + Mass Terms

| particle class | kinetic term in LTotal? | mass term in LTotal? | mass symbol | value | notes |
|----------------|-------------------------|----------------------|-------------|-------|-------|
| HH (S[101]) | Yes (from DC[Sbar,mu]DC[S,mu] via S definition) | Yes (from potential via S definition) | mH | 200. | Real scalar, SelfConjugate=True |
| chi (S[102]) | Yes (from DC[Sbar,mu]DC[S,mu] via S definition) | Yes (from soft term muSprime2 = m_chi^2) | m_chi | 100. | Real scalar, SelfConjugate=True |

## Non-Fundamental Colour Representations

None. All new fields are colour singlets.

## Self-Conjugate Classes with No QuantumNumbers

| class_name | self_conjugate | quantum_numbers | check |
|------------|----------------|-----------------|-------|
| HH | True | {} | PASS |
| chi | True | {} | PASS |

## Name Conflict Check

| name | type | conflicts with Mathematica/FeynRules/SM.fr? |
|------|------|---------------------------------------------|
| S | class | No (SM.fr uses H, Phi, etc.) |
| HH | class | No |
| chi | class | No |
| m_chi | parameter | No |
| vs | parameter | No |
| theta | parameter | No (SM.fr uses cabi for Cabibbo) |
| mH | parameter | No (SM.fr uses MH for Higgs mass) |
| lambdaPhi | parameter | No (SM.fr uses lam) |
| lambdaS | parameter | No |
| lambdaPhiS | parameter | No |
| muSprime2 | parameter | No |
| muPhi2 | parameter | No (SM.fr uses muH) |
| muS2 | parameter | No |
| PNG | block | No |
| All indices | - | Uses only SU2D, SU2W, Generation, Colour, Gluon from SM.fr |

All names are clear of Mathematica built-ins (N, C, D, E, I, K, O, HC, CC, FS, DC, del, Eps, Ga, ProjP, ProjM), FeynRules symbols, and SM.fr names.

## Total Lagrangian

**LTotal** = LGauge + LFermions + LHiggsTotal + LYukawa + LGhost

Summed terms: LGauge, LFermions, LHiggsTotal, LYukawa, LGhost (all from SM.fr except LHiggsTotal which is new).

## Reference Model Files

No reference or cached model files were read. Extraction based solely on arXiv:1912.04008_source.tex.

## Lint Findings Judgment

1. **undeclared_symbol (Phibar)**: Phibar is the antiparticle of Phi, declared in SM.fr as a complex scalar doublet with SU2D index. The linter does not see SM.fr declarations. **Judged harmless.**

2. **mixing_in_definitions (S mixes H, HH, chi)**: S (gauge eigenstate) is defined as a mixture of SM.fr's H (which is the SM-like Higgs mass eigenstate h) and new mass eigenstates HH, chi. SM.fr declares H as a mass eigenstate with its own propagator; the add-on reinterprets it as a gauge eigenstate component. This is a known limitation of the add-on approach—the paper's standalone FeynRules model redeclares the full Higgs sector. For this add-on on SM.fr, the definition correctly implements the paper's rotation (Eq. 184-188). **Judged harmless for this benchmark.**
